description: Synthetic delivery dataset of one cardholder account at a fictional card issuer: the account opened on 2 December 2024, and the history runs to 2026-12-31T23:00:00-05:00. Every record is synthetic: the issuer, the cardholder, the merchants, the banks and the loyalty programs are fictional, and nothing was collected. A development script builds stories from fixed templates with a seeded PRNG and replays every step through the App's own hooks, so the App made every payment, dispute, redemption and notification.

sources.description: Scripted synthetic card account history from story templates with seeded random variation; no external collection and no real person, issuer, merchant, card number, bank or loyalty program. Dates are represented event dates of the fictional history, not collection dates.

generation.method: scripted replay of story templates with a seeded PRNG (mulberry32)

transformations: None. The seed is the App state after the replay.

review.notes: Automated checks do not replace human review of realism and variation.
